overloads.semanticRole: Changes the currently displayed page of the parent form (or, if the trailing * flag is passed, of the current page-type subform) to pageNumber, clamped to the valid page range.

constraints: Does nothing if no form is displayed/loaded (via FORM LOAD), or if pageNumber is already the current page.
pageNumber is clamped: values greater than the number of pages display the last page, and values less than one display the first page.
By default (no *), always applies to the parent form even when called from within a subform's method.
